title: Two-minute hand stretch
howTo: No guitar yet. Follow the timer: shake out, forearms, fingers, thumbs.
Gentle and slow. Stop if anything hurts.

steps.text: Shake both hands loose, arms relaxed.
Forearm flexor stretch: arm out, palm up; the other hand eases the fingers down and back.
Forearm extensor stretch: arm out, palm down; the other hand eases the fingers toward you.
Spread the fingers wide, then close them. Ten times.
Thumb circles: five each way, both hands.
Make a loose fist and open it slowly. Five times.
